title: Overhead Skip Pass Circuit
description: Players rotate through stations practising the two-hand overhead pass needed to skip the ball across the court past a defense that has collapsed.

content.objective: Deliver a long, accurate skip pass overhead across the width of the court.
content.setup: Players pair up on opposite sides of the court, roughly ten metres apart.
instructions: Bring the ball overhead with both hands, elbows bent at about 90 degrees.
Step and release the ball in one motion, aiming slightly ahead of the receiver.
The receiver catches it in a position ready to shoot or drive immediately.
Switch who initiates the skip pass every six reps.
coachingPoints: Keep the pass high enough to clear defenders but not a lazy lob.
Release from behind the head, not from the chest.
Catch the pass with the feet already set to shoot.
commonMistakes: Winding up too much before releasing, telegraphing the pass.
Throwing the pass flat instead of with an arc that clears traffic.
Telegraphing the pass with the eyes before releasing it.
content.safety: Make sure the flight path is clear of other groups before releasing.
